name: Recovery Code Rejected
summary: The anonymous user submits recovery proof that cannot be accepted, no reset authority is established, and the client remains in the recovery-code state with a neutral invalid-or-expired result.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and auth.password.reset.sent is visible

inputs.name: Recovery Code
inputs.description: Recovery code that is malformed, expired, consumed, exhausted, mismatched, or otherwise ineligible.

serverInteraction.intent: Reject invalid or ineligible recovery proof without establishing password-reset authority and without exposing the internal rejection reason.

postconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and auth.password.reset.sent remains visible and no password-reset authority is established

sourceReferences.note: VerifyPasswordResetCodeAsync collapses malformed, unknown-user, expired, consumed, attempt-exhausted, and mismatched proof into the same public rejection.
Internal recovery-proof rejection reasons are runtime/test permutations beneath one canonical Password Recovery Rejected scenario.
